Vendored dashboard libraries (MIT licensed)

The files are unmodified downloads. Their pinned source URLs are recorded in
scripts/update_vendor_assets.sh. Existing license banners are preserved.

https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/blob/v3.4.17/LICENSE
